title: Edge-Aware and Content-Adaptive Infrared Gas Leak Detection for Industrial Safety Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2512.23234v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Infrared gas leak detection is important for industrial safety and environmental monitoring, but automatic detection remains challenging because gas plumes are often faint, small, semi-transparent, and weakly bounded. This study proposes an Edge-Aware and Content-Adaptive Feature Fusion Detector (ECAF-Det) for infrared gas leak detection in weak-plume and cluttered thermal scenes. The main methodological contributions of ECAF-Det comprise three task-oriented components. A local--global feature enhancement block preserves fine boundary cues and long-range plume continuity. A multi-scale edge perception module transforms directional-gradient and Gabor-response cues into hierarchical boundary-sensitive structural priors. A content-adaptive sparse routing path aggregation network dynamically regulates multi-scale feature propagation and limits the contribution of less informative cross-scale responses. Experiments on the IIG datase

translated_title: 面向工业安全监测的边缘感知与内容自适应红外气体泄漏检测
translated_abstract: 红外气体泄漏检测对工业安全和环境监测至关重要，但由于气体羽流通常微弱、细小、半透明且边界模糊，自动检测仍然极具挑战性。本研究提出了一种边缘感知与内容自适应特征融合检测器，用于弱羽流和杂乱热场景下的红外气体泄漏检测。ECAF-Det 的主要方法学贡献包括三个面向任务的组件：局部-全局特征增强模块，用于保留精细的边界线索和长程羽流连续性；多尺度边缘感知模块，将方向梯度与 Gabor 响应线索转化为层次化的边界敏感结构先验；内容自适应稀疏路由路径聚合网络，动态调节多尺度特征传播并限制信息量较低的跨尺度响应的贡献。在 IIG 数据集上的实验（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出边缘感知与内容自适应特征融合检测器 ECAF-Det，通过局部-全局特征增强、多尺度边缘感知和内容自适应稀疏路由三大组件，有效提升了弱羽流与杂乱热场景下红外气体泄漏的自动检测能力。
en_tdlr: The proposed ECAF-Det integrates local-global feature enhancement, multi-scale edge perception, and content-adaptive sparse routing to achieve robust automatic infrared gas leak detection in faint-plume and cluttered thermal scenes.
